agreements: The minimum canary is worth preserving: public-only projection, audit-only generated prose, model-self-supported closed rows, literal M0 and matched OWN/DIST branches, prospectively fixed M1_OWN transport, fresh atomic thinkers, conditional exactly-two-adapter transport, and monotone human-governed stages form an appropriate one-pair existence and failure-localization skeleton.

v1b genuinely improves on v1a by excluding generated prediction, reason, and confidence text from cognition; removing RAW_RAG and GOLD_OPEN_LOOP; freezing six DEV lives and the 31-predictor shortcut vector; using separate 44/48 per-life adapter gates and matched rosters; strengthening runtime receipts; narrowing claims; and preserving the unconditional human terminal.

The aggregate ceilings reconcile as maxima: 216 DEV controller operations, 632 heldout-text operations, at most 48 conditional LoRA-stage 32B operations, 896 total conditional controller operations, exactly two conditional fits, 96 fidelity cases, and at most 48 online adapter reads; early terminal operations must reduce dispatch rather than create retries.

The exact v1b bytes are not uniquely executable or fail-closed. Outcome-relevant operation state, recurrence, DIST construction, row reduction, intervention ordering, thinker termination, training examples, LoRA reader results, validity routing, and authority artifacts remain missing or contradictory.
The strict visibility precedence makes Stage T unreachable because the final goal is both forbidden until path and sham manifests seal and required to construct those manifests.

Missing dreamed ROLE_EQUIV or CAUSAL_JOIN roots is a valid failure of the tested constructor when benchmark and runtime preconditions hold; it must not be erased as INVALID_PRECONDITION. Positive text credit also requires prospectively designated, offline-correct relations and nondecorative returned use.
Same-model SELF_CHECK remains fallible model-claimed support, never verification, and no repair may introduce semantic truth checking or hidden-answer feedback into the cognitive loop.

Any eventual terminal wording must foreground that this is a game-specific ontology and proof-sequence scaffolded engineering-ceiling-style diagnostic on one aligned seed-5 pair. It cannot support the frozen Paper-1 headline or claims of reliability, scale, saturation, superiority, durability, autonomous discovery, learned control, or a flywheel.

No interpretation, critique, consensus, reviewer, advocate, or later human decision can convert these blocking technical findings into implementation authority. A narrow repaired proposal must be newly hash-bound and deliberated before exact human ratification can release CPU implementation only.

disagreements.issue: Whether the published operation contract fixes one model-visible state and one recurrent treatment.

positions.position: The prompt, profiles, 46/22/16 schedule, six-row cap, selector sort keys, IDs, and seed formula are presented as exact enough to make recurrence uniquely executable.

EVENT and ROW envelopes, E-cited SELF_CHECK premises, recurrence-mode candidate predicates, counter state, branch scope, seed profile and slot registries, state-token derivation, atom namespaces, and scratch variants remain outcome-relevant choices.
Implementation-generated golden vectors cannot choose among these alternatives after ratification; the missing schemas and algorithms must be protocol bytes.

resolution.rationale: The reviewers' position is supported by the contracts. Sort keys do not define candidate pools or updates, and descriptive envelopes do not identify provider-visible bytes. The current proposal is therefore unreleasable even though the finite schedule is worth retaining.
resolution.selected_position: Require a narrow successor to bind closed schemas and canonical vectors for every operation envelope and scratch variant, exact EVENT-to-row and E-to-premise handling, all mode predicates and counter updates, branch-local state, complete seed profile/slot enumeration, state-token derivation, and atom namespace mapping.
resolution.required_change: Bind closed schemas and canonical vectors for every envelope, exact E-to-M handling, mode pools and counter updates, branch state, seed slots, state-token derivation, and atom namespaces in the protocol itself; implementation-generated golden vectors may verify but not choose those semantics.

disagreements.issue: Whether Stage T can both hide the final goal until intervention manifests seal and use that goal to construct those manifests.

positions.position: The final animal, question, and answer remain absent until both intervention exclusion manifests are sealed.
The public final goal is revealed before path and sham manifests seal because their roots, protected rows, and matching depend on its animal, source, and target.
Strict precedence chooses the first rule, so the information needed to construct the manifests is forbidden and Stage T necessarily terminates INVALID_PRECONDITION.

resolution.rationale: Both orders cannot hold, and the proposal's own strict-precedence clause makes the contradiction blocking rather than discretionary.
resolution.selected_position: Use one prospective order in a newly bound successor: seal M0, M1_OWN, M1_DIST, fidelity rows, and shared candidates; reveal the public final goal; deterministically seal path and sham manifests; execute and seal every T arm; then score offline.
resolution.required_change: Replace every contradictory sentence with the selected single order and golden-test it as an authority and visibility invariant before any heldout dispatch.

disagreements.issue: Whether DIST has an authorized prospective derivation compatible with the audit-taint firewall.

positions.position: OWN and DIST may differ by a presealed focus tuple while all generated audit state and forbidden fields are byte-inert.
The only named distractor endpoints are audit-only, no alternative public derivation or DEFER rule exists, and selector-visible focus is deliberately behavior-affecting.
Using audit endpoints violates separation, choosing other endpoints is implementation-selected, and P1CB02 incorrectly treats registered focus mutation as inert.

resolution.rationale: A matched control must vary an authorized treatment field, while unrelated audit/private mutations remain inert. The present contract conflates those domains and does not define the control.
resolution.selected_position: Add a separately typed prospective-control manifest derived by one fixed authorized public rule before branch results; specify DEFER behavior and all matched fields; authorize only its DIST focus tuple; keep audit-only distractor metadata incapable of affecting any other request.
resolution.required_change: Add the prospective-control manifest and fixed public derivation, specify DEFER behavior and exact OWN/DIST equality fields, and scope P1CB02 noninterference to unauthorized focus echoes plus audit/private mutations rather than the registered treatment field.

disagreements.issue: Whether SELF_CHECK independent support and immutable row-state evolution are operational without a semantic verifier.

positions.position: A disjoint-lineage counterevidence row can qualify INDEPENDENT_CORROBORATION, and the reducer can assign a terminal status to the owned PROVISIONAL row while retaining immutable rows and record hashes.

Without an explicit model-cited support relation, the harness must either judge semantic support or accept any unrelated disjoint row; the proposal also omits the exact projection/version rule for changed status and record_hash.

The protocol needs schema-visible model-claimed support IDs, a complete legal state table, and append-only event-sourced proposal and terminal projections rather than hidden mutation or truth checking.

resolution.rationale: The existing condition is not mechanically decidable as written, and the memory schema alone admits incompatible state combinations. Repair must preserve fallible same-model support rather than add an exact verifier.
resolution.selected_position: Define model-claimed distinct-lineage support entirely through explicit SELF_CHECK output and schema-visible IDs; require cited support rows; bind every origin/status/support_basis/citation/depth combination; and derive canonical proposal and terminal row projections and hashes from append-only events.
resolution.required_change: Define model-claimed distinct-lineage support entirely through explicit model output and schema-visible IDs, require cited support rows, bind every origin/status/basis/citation/depth combination, and define canonical event-sourced projections and record hashes at proposal and terminal states without a truth checker.

disagreements.issue: Whether the twelve-operation thinker boundary, early stopping, DEV receipts, and validity classes yield one terminal and ledger result.

positions.position: Every nonterminal response appends a scratch node, scratch permits eleven nodes, overflow is INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE, and the twelfth nonterminal response is also a normal BUDGET_EXHAUSTED terminal.
COMMIT or DEFER ends a loop and 216 is a maximum, so early terminals reduce actual calls.

positions.actor: development fixture and review packet wording
positions.position: NO_MEMORY adaptive_stopping=false and all-216 or partial-manifest language can be read as literal full dispatch despite terminal operations.

resolution.rationale: The same twelfth response cannot be both normal budget exhaustion and infrastructure invalidity, and continuing after a registered terminal violates the thinker contract. A total routing table is required because stage authority depends on the distinction.
resolution.selected_position: Bind one twelve-operation reducer with one terminal classification, stop immediately on terminal operations, treat all call totals as ceilings, create explicit non-dispatch terminal accounting, and map every model, protocol, control, runtime, and partial-fit outcome to exactly one validity class and ledger effect.
resolution.required_change: Bind one twelve-operation reducer, make call counts unambiguously ceilings with non-dispatch terminal accounting, and publish a total validity/dispatch table covering malformed JSON, schema-valid illegal operations, CONFLICT, DEFER, budget exhaustion, missing roots, infeasible sham, refusal, timeout, truncation, output-limit stop, runtime drift, and partial-fit failure before execution.

resolution.selected_position: Classify missing required dreamed abstraction classes as VALID_STAGE_FAILURE when benchmark/runtime preconditions hold; reserve INVALID_PRECONDITION for independently infeasible prospective controls; designate candidate path rows from sealed manifests before scoring; require offline-correct relations and explicit returned-and-used evidence; and golden-test sham pool sufficiency, ties, assignment, and infeasibility.
resolution.required_change: Treat missing dreamed root classes as VALID_STAGE_FAILURE when benchmark/runtime preconditions hold; reserve INVALID_PRECONDITION for independently infeasible controls.
